tools.name: search_skus
tools.description: Search SF beverage SKUs by item name, with optional category filter and geo search. Returns sku_id, merchant, distance, size, and price in integer cents.

tools.name: get_sku
tools.description: Full detail for one SKU: item, merchant, location, and every option group with choices and price deltas (cents).

tools.name: price_order
tools.description: Compute an order total: total_cents = sku.price_cents + SUM(option.price_delta_cents). Validates option_ids against the SKU; rejects unknown or inapplicable options.
